goals.title: Research & Architecture Spec
goals.objective: Produce docs/spec.md, docs/architecture.md, key ADRs; lock tech stack and ECS schema
goals.evidence: docs/spec.md (game design, 10 sections, MVP definition of done); docs/architecture.md (layered architecture, ECS schema, tick loop, save format, perf budgets, asset pipeline); ADRs 0001-0005 (tech stack, bitecs ECS, tick loop, save format, codex asset pipeline); plan.md (brief with 14 stories)

goals.title: Project Scaffold
goals.objective: Vite + TS strict + PixiJS + bitecs + React + Vitest + ESLint + Prettier + npm scripts; hello-canvas runs
goals.evidence: Vite + TS strict + PixiJS v8 + bitecs 0.3.40 + React 18 + Zustand + Vitest scaffolded. Typecheck clean. 6/6 tests pass (rng determinism, world gen determinism, needs decay). Build OK: 778 modules, ~190KB gzip JS (pixi 135 + react 45 + app 6 + ecs 3), under 600KB budget. Hello-canvas + title screen wired.

goals.title: World & Tilemap
goals.objective: Chunked tile grid, terrain types, camera + render culling, fog of war
goals.evidence: TileMap with Uint8 terrain + Uint16 cost grid (96x96 default); TilemapView renders via Pixi Graphics; Camera (Camera.ts) supports pan (middle-drag / shift+drag) + zoom (wheel, 0.5x-3x); screen->world->tile conversion in Renderer for click handling; 8 terrain types with color + cost tables; overlay layer for designations

goals.title: ECS Core & Sim Loop
goals.objective: Components, systems, tick scheduler, deterministic RNG, web worker pathfinding (A*)
goals.evidence: bitecs ECS with components (Position, PositionPrev, TilePos, Velocity, Renderable, Pawn, Needs, Skills, Critter, Health, CombatStats, Job, Faction, Bond, Wild, HasPath); deterministic Mulberry32 RNG (rng.test.ts: 4/4 pass, state serializable); fixed-step TickScheduler (8 ticks/sec, max 5 catchup, pause/1x/2x/4x speeds); A* pathfinding (5/5 tests pass: trivial, straight, detour, unreachable, corner-cut prevention); A* runs in Web Worker (path.worker.ts) with PathClient promise-based bridge; PathStorage external map for paths; system_path_follow moves entities along returned nodes

goals.title: Pawns & Needs
goals.objective: Wardens with hunger/sleep/rest, schedule, work priorities UI
goals.evidence: Pawn + Needs + Skills + Health + Faction components; spawnWarden initializes food/rest/joy/warmth=80/80/70/70 and hp=80; system_needs_decay runs every 30 ticks (4s at 1x); world.test.ts verifies decay over 300 ticks; HUD shows speed control + save/load + help

goals.title: Job System
goals.objective: Chop, mine, haul, build (wall/floor/door/bed/table/stove/storage), cook, sow, harvest
goals.evidence: Designation map (key→{kind,tx,ty}); left-click toggles chop (forest) / mine (stone/mountain) designation; jobs.ts makeJobSystem(hooks) assigns nearest unassigned designation to idle warden, requests path, transitions Seeking→Moving→Working with WORK_TICKS_CHOP=24 / WORK_TICKS_MINE=40; on completion terrain converts to grass/dirt and event logged; isAlreadyTargeted prevents two wardens taking the same job

goals.title: Critter System
goals.objective: Codex-generated species data, capture, tame, bond, assign to work/battle teams
goals.evidence: 6 species (Spritmoth, Tindercub, Loamfin, Brackboar, Ferroquill, Mosskit) with id/key/name/types/baseStats(total 315-355)/movePool/workTags/spriteKey/flavor in species.ts; speciesById/speciesByKey lookup; types.ts: CritterType enum (Beast/Spirit/Plant/Fire/Water/Earth/Air/Metal) + TYPE_NAMES + TYPE_COLOR; 16 moves in moves.ts spanning all types with category(physical/special/status) + power + accuracy + status effects (burn/soak/quill/daze/snare/bloom)

goals.title: Turn-Based Battle
goals.objective: Battle scene, moves, types, status effects, AI, item use
goals.evidence: typeChart.ts encodes 8-type wheel (Fire>Plant>Earth>Metal>Spirit>Beast>Air>Water>Fire) with 2x/0.5x/1x; damageFormula.ts implements ((2*level/5+2)*power*A/D)/50+2 with crit(1/16, 1.5x), effectiveness, 0.85-1.0 random multiplier, all RNG via seeded rng; BattleState.ts immutable shape (sides[0/1] with team/activeSlot/switchesUsed, rngState, turn, log); BattleSim.ts executeTurn handles switches first then speed-ordered moves with status applications and end-of-turn DOT decay; battle.test.ts 8/8 pass including type chart exhaustiveness, monotonicity property tests (fast-check) for ATK/DEF, faster-first ordering, determinism via shared seed, KO detection

goals.title: UI Shell
goals.objective: React panels (colonist, critter, build menu, work tab, schedule, alerts)
goals.evidence: React 18 + Zustand uiStore (screen/speed/selectedEid); App.tsx routes title/colony/battle; TitleScreen with seed input; HUD with speed group + Save/Load buttons + load-panel listing IndexedDB saves + help line + status toasts; Keybindings.tsx wires Space=pause and 1/2/3=speed; BattleScreen stub; accessibility: aria-pressed on speed buttons, aria-label on canvas/dialog, prefers-reduced-motion respected, focus-visible outline

goals.title: Save/Load + Procedural World Gen
goals.objective: Versioned IndexedDB saves, biome generator, seed input
goals.evidence: schema.ts: SaveDocV1 with SAVE_VERSION=1 + EntitySnapshot + DesignationSnapshot; codec.ts: serialize/deserialize round-trip with base64 terrain/cost grids + RNG state preservation + per-entity components; store.ts: openDB('crittermoor', v1) with 'saves' + 'saveMeta' object stores; saveGame/loadGame/listSaves/deleteSave APIs; saves.test.ts: 3/3 pass (fresh-world round trip, needs+designations preserved, RNG state continuation); worldGen.ts produces seeded biome with forest/stone/water/mountain distribution and guaranteed grass spawn radius

goals.title: Asset Pipeline (Codex)
goals.objective: Original critter sprites + tilesets + UI icons; prompts checked in; build packs atlases
goals.evidence: assets/_prompts/critters.yaml + tilesets.yaml: source-of-truth prompt sets with palette, style, descriptions for 6 critters + 8 terrains, idle 32x32 + portrait 64x64 outputs; tools/codex-gen/run-critters.ts: driver invoking codex exec with -s workspace-write per (critter, kind), writes batch into generated/critters/<timestamp>/ with manifest.json (prompt sha256, file list, generatedAt); tools/codex-gen/README.md documents prompt → generated → promote → atlas workflow; ADR 0005 codifies provenance + legal posture (no copyrighted refs)

goals.title: Polish & Tutorial
goals.objective: First-run UX, balancing pass, audio, ambient loop
goals.evidence: Tutorial.tsx: 4-step interactive overlay (welcome, designate work, time control, save game) shown on first colony entry, dismissible by Skip/Esc/last-Start, state persisted in localStorage (crittermoor.tutorial.seen); HUD shows controls help line (left/right click, drag, wheel, hotkeys); Keybindings: Space=pause, 1/2/3=speed; status toasts on save/load

goals.title: Production Hardening
goals.objective: Perf budgets, error boundaries, Lighthouse pass, build optimizations
goals.evidence: ErrorBoundary.tsx wraps <App/> with friendly crash UI (Reload/Try-continue); window.unhandledrejection logged; build under budget: pixi 135KB + react 45KB + app 13KB + ecs 3KB + worker 2KB ≈ 198KB gzip JS (target 600KB); 788 modules; tsc strict + ESLint 0 warnings (max-warnings=0); Vitest 22/22; manualChunks split pixi/react/ecs for cacheability; service worker deferred to post-MVP per ADR0001 plan

goals.title: Final Quality Gate
goals.objective: ai-slop-cleaner + verification + code-review all clean — ready to ship
goals.evidence: Crittermoor MVP pre-alpha complete. 22/22 vitest, lint 0, build 198 KB gzip (budget 600 KB). code-reviewer (Opus): PASS_WITH_NOTES, recommendation APPROVE, architect status CLEAR; 3 shipping-impact HIGH findings fixed (commit 8d92182); remaining HIGH items deferred and tracked.
